Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” as the father’s father’s mother (Antoine de Bourbon’s mother, Françoise d’Alençon) instead of the father’s mother. This contradicted earlier correct understanding (that Henry IV is Gaston’s father and his mother is Jeanne d’Albret) and led to the incorrect identification.
